rationale: The Latin anchor *siliqua* specifically denotes the pod or outer shell enclosing seeds (e.g. a legume husk), which maps directly to husk.n.02 (outer membranous covering of some fruits or seeds); *bulga* and *follis* (bag, bellows/sack) further support a discrete enclosing membrane rather than loose, separated chaff material (chaff.n.01). The Psalm citation (Ps. Spl. M. 118, 83) is consistent with a withered/shrivelled husk, reinforcing the seed-covering sense.
